decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The proposed gym and therapy centre is a small scale and low intensity employment use, aimed at serving the local community. Despite its out of town centre location is considered that the proposal is sufficiently served by public transport to be in accordance with policies E.1.5 (Development Involving Loss of/ Changes in Employment Land) and C.5.1 (New Leisure Development) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.
description: Change of use from office, to Personal training gym and therapy centre.
